verdict.rationale: Xero publishes an official MCP server (xero-mcp-server) with documented protocol compliance for contacts, invoices, and chart-of-accounts management, and this is corroborated by a live official documentation page at developer.xero.com/documentation/tools/mcp-server as well as an 'AI Toolkit' page referencing the MCP Server alongside OpenAI Agents SDK/LangChain support. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer reports actually using the MCP server in production and more detail on server capabilities/limitations beyond the README bullet list.
